test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 4: Teacher Responds and Updates the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher uploads an additional reference document to a course
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is logged in and has navigated to the 'Course Details Page' for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. The system displays the course information, including the 'Files' tab. The previous actions (Login, Create Course, Edit Course Information, Create Session, Upload Syllabus, Logout, Student Registration, Student Logout, Teacher Login, Enroll Student, Teacher Logout, Student Login, Forum Interaction, Student Logout, Teacher Login, Forum Reply, Edit Session) have been successfully completed, establishing the necessary course context.
test_cases.expected_result: The system successfully uploads the 'reference_document.pdf' file and adds it to the course. The 'Files' tab is updated to display the new file. The system reports a successful upload.
test_cases.post_condition: The 'reference_document.pdf' file is visible in the 'Files' tab of the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course on the 'Course Details Page'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Files' tab to navigate to the file management section.
Click the 'Add File' button to open the 'Add files Modal (from Files Tab)'.
Select the 'reference_document.pdf' file for upload in the 'File Uploader' area.
Click the 'Upload Button' to initiate the file upload.
